messages.en: Are there any eggs left at home? I want to make breakfast.
Yeah, I bought some yesterday. They're in the fridge.

senses.en_definition: A companion; someone who keeps another person company or shares an activity; in certain expressions, a life partner.
Something that accompanies or complements something else.

collocations.en: an accompaniment to betel leaf, such as areca nut
a snack to go with afternoon tea

senses.en_definition: I; me (a first-person pronoun used in some Perak dialects).

messages.en: I'm thinking of going to the night market tonight, but I've got no one to go with. Are you free?
Yeah, I'm free. I want to grab something to eat there too. Shall we go after Maghrib prayers?
Sounds good! I'll pick you up at your place.

senses.en_definition: To fire a gun; to shoot at someone or something.
In football, to kick the ball towards the goal (Indonesian usage).
To make things up, tell lies, or deceive someone (figurative).

messages.en: There's someone up ahead. Can I shoot him?
Hey, don't shoot yet! He's on our team! Look at the name above his head.
Oh, that explains it. I didn't see his name just now. Good thing you told me.

senses.en_definition: A shot or discharge from a gun or similar weapon.
The explosive sound of a gun or other firearm being fired.

messages.en: What movie are you watching? The gunfire's so loud I can hear it from my room.
Just an action movie. Sorry, I'll turn the TV down now. I didn't realise it was that loud.
